sources.title: MimicMotion - Tencent
sources.snippet: MimicMotion integrates an image-to-video diffusion model with novel confidence-aware pose guidance. The model's trainable components consist of a spatiotemporal U-Net and a PoseNet for introducing pose sequence as the condition.

sources.title: MimicMotion: Image-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MimicMotion generates high-quality human motion videos from a single input image guided by pose sequences, developed by tencent. The model uses confidence-aware pose guidance to control human motion in video generation, fine-tuned on top of Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) from Stability AI. sources.title: mimic-motion: Image-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MimicMotion generates high-quality human motion videos by taking a reference image for appearance and a reference video for motion guidance, producing videos of arbitrary length with pose-controlled motion synthesis. Built by zsxkib, the model combines Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) as a base with confidence-aware pose guidance, regional loss amplification, and progressive latent fusion ...
